description:
MEASURED 2026-08-12, and PRE-EXISTING (byte-identical on d9abc55616 and on the TUAS-convention branch, so not introduced by the boundary work).

SETUP. Forward-only advected thermal front, no reversal. L=4 m, A=0.02 m2, 4 MPa water seeded 400 K, inlet junction 450 K, prescribed 3.2 kg/s inlet, fixed 4 MPa outlet pressure, PIMPLE(3,2) at 0.3 under-relaxation, dt=5 ms, 12000 steps.

SYMPTOM. A single-cell enthalpy spike parks at the SECOND-TO-LAST cell (the outlet-adjacent neighbour) and does not decay. Worst overshoot above the inlet junction enthalpy, as a fraction of the 215.4 kJ/kg span between seed and inlet:
  n=8   39.20%  (profile tail ... 748.1, 750.6, 835.3, 750.5)
  n=16  41.36%
  n=32  42.33%  (tail ... 785.7, 777.3, 842.1, 777.1)
  n=64  42.61%  (tail ... 801.3, 787.1, 842.6, 786.9)

KEY POINT: it does NOT converge with mesh refinement - it SATURATES at ~42.6%. A dispersive truncation error would shrink. The spike is always at index n-2 and is a classic odd-even/checkerboard mode anchored at the fixed-pressure outlet.

DISTINCT FROM op-1fyp. op-1fyp records fvc::div(phi,he) as pure central differencing giving 10-15% over/undershoot at an advected front. That is a travelling-front effect and is mesh-convergent. This is boundary-localised, 3-4x larger, and mesh-INVARIANT, so it is a separate defect - most likely the outlet pressure/velocity BC pairing (boundary phi is never pressure-corrected, cf op-nnqi) rather than the interior scheme.

WHY IT MATTERS. For a boiling stream an enthalpy overshoot of this size can push a (p,h) flash out of range and panic. It also sets the floor on any enthalpy-boundedness assertion: the reversal V&V test flow_reversal_keeps_enthalpy_bounded_between_terminals has to carry a forward-only control arm and assert relative to it, because the scheme violates boundedness by ~39% before any reversal is involved.

REPRO: crates/tampines-steam-tables, tests::flow_reversal_keeps_enthalpy_bounded_between_terminals (forward-only control arm).
title: TampinesSteamArray: outlet-anchored odd-even enthalpy oscillation, ~40% of span, NOT mesh-convergent
